inputs.goal: source a data-warehouse vendor under a 120k budget, award by Q4

rfp.reduce.output:
Vendor Shortlist for Data Warehouse Solution

Based on the evaluation of the three shortlisted vendors within the $120k budget and Q4 2023 timeline, Google BigQuery emerges as the optimal choice. While all vendors meet the basic requirements, Google BigQuery offers unique advantages including serverless architecture, real-time analytics capabilities, and strong SQL support, which aligns well with our data processing needs.

Vendor Comparison:
1. Snowflake - $115,000, Q4 2023
   Features: cloud-native, auto-scaling, SQL support
   Status: shortlisted

2. Amazon Redshift - $105,000, Q4 2023
   Features: AWS integration, columnar storage, SQL support
   Status: shortlisted

3. Google BigQuery - $110,000, Q4 2023
   Features: serverless, SQL support, real-time analytics
   Status: shortlisted

Recommendation:
Google BigQuery is recommended for award due to its serverless architecture and real-time analytics capabilities that provide better scalability and performance for our data warehouse needs.
